averaging 0.6 a hole - the blue balls are warming up
2 clear and finished - now a full-time Cosh supporter
safe by 4 unless the course gets generous late
in on a 7-point buffer - watching the door like everyone else
7 clear from the bar stool - the best kind of clear
7 from the double blue - a wipe here would be extremely on-brand
in the clubhouse, 8 points of daylight, one nervous eye on the scorers
finished 8 above the blue line - toasting every point Cosh does not score
done and 8 above the drop - his interest in Cosh's round is intense and personal
